primary.title: Reporting capital gains on equity and debt MFs? Here's a step-by-step guide
primary.summary: While most of the changes to capital gains taxation were implemented in FY24-25 or AY25-26, taxpayers filing returns this year for AY26-27 still need to navigate a detailed reporting framework, particularly for equity transactions.
